title: Production acceptance: activate daily diagnostic retention cleanup
evidence_required: FT-007-AC-006 RED: the repository and pilot-host handoff have no source-managed daily retention service/timer, so no owner is assigned to activate the accepted cleanup command and ordinary expiry depends on an ad hoc manual invocation; GREEN: the reviewed one-shot service and persistent daily timer are installed unchanged on the explicitly authorized pilot host, enabled and active, invoke only the deployed owner-ordered cleanup command, expose a daily next trigger and produce one matching authorized latest-result observation without an internal scheduler or jobs subsystem; decisive comparison: source/installed unit hashes, redacted systemd enabled/active/list-timers state and latest run identity before/after one authorized service invocation; artifact: unit verification and redacted pilot-host activation receipts under .tasks/TASK-087-T3-FT-007-W4/.
purpose: Assign and prove the production-only pilot-host activation that makes the reviewed idempotent cleanup command run daily without adding application scheduling machinery.
success_outcome: The authorized pilot host has one source-managed persistent daily timer invoking only the accepted cleanup command, with observable activation and latest-result evidence.
anti_goals: Do not change cleanup cutoffs, deletion ordering, latest-result schema, staff authorization or application business logic owned by TASK-086.
Do not add an internal scheduler, jobs/history table, queue, cron container, retry daemon or credential store.
Do not install or enable units on an unapproved host or manually select/delete participant records.

forbidden_scope: Unapproved hosts, systemd instances and deployment directories
Manual production PostgreSQL/MinIO mutation outside the reviewed cleanup command
Application cleanup/auth code, database migrations and FT-008..FT-011 behavior
stop_conditions: The exact pilot host, deployment directory or installation authority is unavailable at execution time.
Activation would require embedding credentials, changing the reviewed cleanup command or adding an internal scheduler/jobs subsystem.
Installed-unit or live-service proof cannot be redacted or bounded to the authorized pilot deployment.
The TASK-086 cleanup command and latest-result surface are not verified and closed.

constraints: Primary operational owner is the authorized pilot-host operator; application cleanup remains promo-owned and the timer invokes only its public command.

Use source-managed systemd service/timer definitions with OnCalendar=daily and Persistent=true; the root-readable host environment file supplies only FACE_MOMENT_PROJECT_DIR and the service uses the exact runbook docker compose command without credentials.

The verification script defaults to read-only source/installed-state checks; a live one-shot invocation requires explicit pilot-host authorization and records only redacted status/latest-result evidence.
This final Production acceptance task has no dependents and remains planned until its authorized host evidence is available.
invariants: Exactly one external timer activates retention daily; overlap is still rejected by the command's PostgreSQL advisory lock.
The timer owns no retention policy, database row, credential or participant-data decision.
Installed units match reviewed source and invoke no command other than the accepted cleanup entrypoint.
Activation evidence exposes no credential, raw object identity, participant payload or traceback.
verification_targets: Source and installed-unit comparison proves the one-shot service invokes only the deployed cleanup entrypoint and the timer is daily, persistent, enabled and active.
Redacted pilot-host evidence records the next trigger and one authorized invocation's matching latest result without manual data mutation or internal scheduling machinery.
